Example electrofishing catch records

Source: R/data.R
example_catch.Rd

A simulated long-format multi-pass electrofishing dataset for four reaches, each surveyed on two dates, with two species and three removal passes per survey. Counts were generated from a constant- probability removal (binomial depletion) model so that depletion estimators recover sensible abundances. Pairs with example_reach.

Usage

example_catch

Format

A data frame with 48 rows and 8 columns:

reach_id

Reach identifier (character), e.g. "R01".

date

Survey date (Date).

pass_number

Removal pass index, 1-3 (integer).

species

Species code (character): "BNT" or "RBT".

count

Number of fish captured on the pass (integer).

effort_seconds

Shocking effort for the pass, in seconds (numeric).

amperage

Mean shocking current for the pass, in amperes (numeric).

voltage

Mean shocking voltage for the pass (numeric).

Details

Generated by data-raw/make_example_data.R with set.seed(42).

See also

example_reach, analyze_cpue()

Other example data: example_reach
